description: Step 1 of agentic signup. Sends a 6-digit verification code to the email. After the user reads the code, call register_organisation_verify with it to finish and receive an API key. Use this when a user wants to create a new FavCRM workspace from inside an MCP client.

country.description: ISO 3166-1 alpha-2 country code (HK, US, GB, ...)

email.description: Owner email — receives a 6-digit code (10 min TTL)

organisationName.description: Business / brand name (used as the first company name too)

timezone.description: IANA timezone (e.g. Asia/Hong_Kong); falls back to country default

name: register_organisation_request

data.description: Tool result payload — shape varies per tool, see the tool description

renderType.description: UI rendering hint for the result

summary.description: One-line human-readable summary of the action
